nextSteps.text: The agent role may not do this: do not retry or look for another route.
Tell the person which access is missing and ask them to grant it.
Show the person this command: it gives the agent the missing access, and init asks for the admin connection string itself.
Tell the agent once the access is granted.

body.personMessage: The agent was denied access to what it asked for. If it should have it, run the command the agent shows you, then tell the agent.
